method: The combined international board uses the verified BA 2027 Top 50 bonus order as a relative backbone, with other amateur and recent-signing profiles inserted through a dated Pipeline scouting comparison. This is a cross-period editorial order, not BA’s talent ranking or a pure bonus list. BA source ranks and tiers remain unchanged. Signing class, official transactions, league eligibility and fantasy ownership remain separate from rank. Low-information placements are provisional and do not imply measured tool quality.

insertions.rationale: Premium prep-starter upside, reported 157 km/h peak, multiple secondaries and first-round-caliber independent evaluation. Behind the leading five BA-backed bats because pitcher attrition, command and secondary consistency create substantial development risk. No acquisition-route penalty.
